name: voice-alerts
description: Voice-call alerts to farmers through Twilio

scripts.demo: node broadcast-calls.js lists/demo.txt --max-seconds 75 --say "Hello. This is Yala-Maha, the irrigation alert service for the Mahaweli B zone. Flood warning: Kudawewa tank is above 90 percent, and the spill gates will open at 6 AM tomorrow. Please move livestock and equipment away from the canal banks. Thank you."
